turns.doctor_question: Has anything particularly stressful or upsetting happened in your life recently?

turns.doctor_question: Since the robbery, have you been avoiding reminders of what happened?

turns.doctor_question: Did these symptoms start right after the robbery?

turns.doctor_question: Since the robbery, have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day?

turns.doctor_question: Since the robbery, have these symptoms been interfering with your day-to-day life?
